 Rep. John Moolenaar, the chairman of the bipartisan House committee on China, said the former Nvidia leader was in discussions to find a suitable time to brief committees. Listen to this article 00:00 00:00 Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang in Tokyo on July 16. Kiyoshi Ota / Bloomberg via Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 12, 2026, 10:32 AM EST By Jared Perlo and Zara Morris Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to brief lawmakers on his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy and the global chip behemoth’s security protocols, according to Rep. John Moolenaar, R-Mich.
